GOVERN.title: Authoritative AI Systems Inventory & Custodianship
GOVERN.concrete_operational_action: Catalog all 9 production AI subsystems (including CX Agent, Carrier Engine, Policies RAG, Return Engine, MCP Server, RFP Workflow, WebSocket Chat, Agent Memory, and Sales Forecast) with assigned technical team leads, operational scope, and data tier classifications.
GOVERN.verification_mechanism: Automated inventory schema tests asserting 100% of AI systems have designated custodians and repository paths.

GOVERN.title: Third-Party AI Provider Shared Responsibility Matrix
GOVERN.concrete_operational_action: Establish demarcated security boundaries for Anthropic, Qdrant Cloud, and courier integrations with zero data retention verification.
GOVERN.verification_mechanism: Automated contract tests asserting TLS 1.3 transit encryption and zero model training retention guarantees.

IDENTIFY.title: Input Attack Surface & Sensitive Data Tier Mapping
IDENTIFY.concrete_operational_action: Map external attack surfaces (customer chat prompts, warehouse notes, carrier webhooks) to data classifications (RESTRICTED_PII, CONFIDENTIAL_B2B).
IDENTIFY.verification_mechanism: AISystemRecord validation asserting non-empty input attack surfaces and explicit classification enum values.

IDENTIFY.title: Residual AI Risk Ledger & Compensatory Safeguards
IDENTIFY.concrete_operational_action: Track prioritized technical and operational gaps with severity ratings, business impacts, and scheduled remediation targets.
IDENTIFY.verification_mechanism: Residual risks query endpoint asserting all active entries have assigned owners and milestones.

PROTECT.title: Prompt Boundary Delimiter Isolation
PROTECT.concrete_operational_action: Envelop all untrusted external content within <<<EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT>>> structural delimiters to prevent prompt injection overrides.
PROTECT.verification_mechanism: Pytest injection regression suite verifying direct and indirect override neutralization.

PROTECT.title: Human-in-the-Loop Authorization Gates for Irreversible Actions
PROTECT.concrete_operational_action: Intercept return refunds > 100 EUR, dispatches > 500 EUR, in-transit carrier changes, and cross-brand metric queries in a thread-safe supervisor queue.
PROTECT.verification_mechanism: Policy evaluation tests asserting transition to PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL and fail-secure timeout handling.

PROTECT.title: Zero Plaintext Credentials in Repository
PROTECT.concrete_operational_action: Enforce 100% environment-driven configuration across all microservices with fail-fast initialization checks.
PROTECT.verification_mechanism: Static git repository scanning asserting zero exposed tokens or private keys in tracked code.

DETECT.title: API Endpoint Rate Limiting & Denial-of-Wallet Defense
DETECT.concrete_operational_action: Enforce sliding-window rate limits (30 req/min) on LLM-invoking endpoints returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After header upon quota breach.
DETECT.verification_mechanism: Integration test triggering 31 rapid requests and asserting downstream LLM token consumption is capped.

DETECT.title: Tool Output Allowlist Gate & Guardrail Violation Logging
DETECT.concrete_operational_action: Validate agent tool proposals against registered Pydantic schemas and record sanitized SecurityAuditLogEntry telemetry.
DETECT.verification_mechanism: Unit tests verifying malformed tool arguments and unregistered tools trigger immediate execution refusal.

RESPOND.title: GDPR 72-Hour AEPD Incident Response & Containment Protocol
RESPOND.concrete_operational_action: Execute structured breach containment (T<=4h), PII impact assessment (T<=12h), DPO risk review (T<=36h), and AEPD formal submission (T<=72h).
RESPOND.verification_mechanism: Incident SLA drill unit test validating containment timelines and formal notification payload generation.

RESPOND.title: CCPA/CPRA Rapid Consumer Breach & Rights Response Runbook
RESPOND.concrete_operational_action: Provide rapid consumer notification workflows and automated endpoints for Right to Access, Delete, and Opt-Out of data sale.
RESPOND.verification_mechanism: Verification of privacy rights endpoint responses and consumer notice templates.

RECOVER.title: Deterministic State Reconstruction & Audit Trail Recovery
RECOVER.concrete_operational_action: Replay tamper-evident security audit logs and LangGraph checkpoints to recover agent conversation state following node failure.
RECOVER.verification_mechanism: State recovery tests asserting checkpoint integrity across interrupted workflows.

residual_risks.description: Carrier API keys currently stored in environment variables rather than dedicated cloud HSM or HashiCorp Vault.
residual_risks.business_impact: Potential carrier credential leakage if host container filesystem or memory is compromised.
compensatory_controls: Encrypted container environment variables at rest
Zero token logging in trace and observability adapters

residual_risks.description: Indirect prompt injection defense in warehouse notes relies on deterministic parameter extraction; novel semantic adversarial evasion possible.
residual_risks.business_impact: Malicious shipping note could manipulate non-critical delivery notes or instructions.
compensatory_controls: Complete segregation of notes from carrier routing logic
Delimiter bounding of all warehouse notes
